identity.name: Tin Arrow Cup
identity.summary: An open tin cylinder with a curled retaining lip.
identity.description: While orthogonally touching the permanent Bowmaster quiver, adds 1 arrows to Volley; this equipment remains in the backpack and is not consumed.
identity.lore: It rattles cheerfully beside a much finer quiver.

effects.description: While orthogonally touching the permanent Bowmaster quiver, adds 1 arrows to Volley; this equipment remains in the backpack and is not consumed.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

empowerment.stacking: once per distinct source and target; different sources add
conditions: Both source and target are equipped.

synergies.description: Pairs with the permanent Bowmaster quiver and other different quiver attachments; normal bows receive no implicit bonus.
